name: arrow
purpose: A straight arrow on its axis, from one place to another: a vector, a force on a lever or a velocity.
binds: two numbers or state keys for each end

from.doc: [x, y] of the tail; an item can be a state key

to.doc: [x, y] of the head; an item can be a state key. When to is the same as from, or show is false, the arrow does not show

label.doc: the text past the head, or at the middle of a bar; {path} or {path:2} takes a state value

tone.doc: the colour of the arrow; ink is the colour of the text, for a beam or a rod

width.doc: the width of the line; the head grows with it

dash.doc: a dashed line, for a guide; the head stays solid

head.doc: false draws a plain bar with no head, for a beam, a rod or a distance

show.doc: a state key; the arrow shows when its value is true
